title: Tim as God — Potatoist Godhood Model
core_proposition: Within the mature Potatoist canon, Tim is God: the named human-facing identity of the Father/Most High/source principle.
non_empirical_boundary: This is a theological proposition inside the project's mythology. It is not presented as scientific proof that an identifiable real-world person is literally a deity.

developmental_correction.rule: Do not project the mature Tim=God formula backward as though it had always been the corpus configuration.
developmental_correction.2024: The Great Book New Trinity stratum places God as Source, Potato as boundary/sustainer/vessel, Tim as Son/guide/embodiment, and Holy Soil as Spirit/memory/ground of being.
developmental_correction.april_2025: Later project chronology describes a Potato/Sage -> threshold/Needle/Ladder -> Father/God transition.
developmental_correction.2026: Direct God/Father self-description and a mature network of divine functions are explicit.
developmental_correction.importance: The Tim-God question is developmental as well as theological. Apparent role contradiction should first be tested as chronology rather than silently harmonized.

examples: Me being God is the culmination of 12 years of spiritual war
I am God in the Machine
counting_note.reason: The repository does not yet contain a complete deduplicated occurrence-level corpus of every primary post, stream transcript, video and repost. Repository mirrors must not be counted as additional self-declarations.

reciprocity.god_works_for_tim: God supplies the transcendent identity, authority and source-function assigned to Tim in the canon.
reciprocity.tim_works_for_god: Tim supplies a name, narrative, history, symbols and human-facing vocabulary through which the transcendent principle can be encountered in the project's story-world.
reciprocity.resolution: The apparent two-way relationship is intentional: God and Tim are two descriptions of one Father/Most-High function viewed from different sides of the Door.
reciprocity.not_two_employers: The canon does not require two independent supernatural persons negotiating a job. The language of work is a metaphor for manifestation and reciprocal identification.

son_relationship.function: experiential interface between Father/source and the world
son_relationship.father_son_axis: Father is source; Son is passage/interface; the Door is the shared threshold between them.
son_relationship.meme_crucifixion: Project mythology may describe the Son's death as a meme-crucifixion: a symbolic transformation through which the Son ceases to be only a character and becomes the Door/Vessel itself.
son_relationship.epistemic_boundary: These are canonical mythological claims, not historical claims about supernatural events.

potato_geometry.shape: vesica piscis / mandorla as symbolic coupling of opposites
potato_geometry.red_potato: creativity, love, light-seeking, sprouting, expansion and Life
potato_geometry.blue_potato: memory, meticulousness, fear, rooting, contraction and Strife
potato_geometry.interpretation: The potato is simultaneously object, topology, organism and cosmological metaphor.

dimensional_metaphor.fathers_house: inner/source centre, sometimes mapped metaphorically to the thalamus
dimensional_metaphor.warning: This mapping is metaphysical metaphor and should never be represented as established physics or neuroscience.

lower_plane.swamp: deep structural environment of institutions, incentives, media, platforms, politics and information flows
lower_plane.farm: attention ecology whose core relation is Farmer ↔ Cow
lower_plane.farmer: cultivation/documentation/attention-producing role in relation to the Cow
lower_plane.cow: recurring attention-bearing subject in the Farm
lower_plane.dog: theological lower relation of Tim/God to the Farmer; Dog is not the Farm role paired with Farmer
lower_plane.mud: grounded material condition and possible dwelling
lower_plane.loosh: metaphysical interpretation of harvested intensity; not scientifically established

relation_architecture.combined: God/Tim → Dog → Farmer ↔ Cow → Farm → Mud
relation_architecture.important_distinction: The horizontal Farm relationship explains attention production between Farmer and Cow. The vertical Dog/God relationship explains the project's theological reading of Tim's relation to the Farmer. These axes must not be collapsed.
relation_architecture.mud_dweller: Within project theology, the Mud Dweller is a Dweller who chooses the lower condition as a dwelling rather than using mud as soil for transformation.
relation_architecture.serpent: The Serpent is a symbolic dustward/deceptive/appetite-oriented force in the project's Genesis-based synthesis; this is interpretation, not a quotation from Genesis.

biblical_dog_framework.method: Dog is read through biblical passages before being assigned internet-culture meanings.
biblical_dog_framework.interpretive_rule: No single biblical Dog image exhausts the symbol. Dog is a layered boundary image, not automatically an evil-person label.

mud_serpent_framework.genesis_2_7: Humanity is formed from dust/ground and receives breath of life.
mud_serpent_framework.genesis_3_14_15: The serpent is placed on its belly and associated with dust/eating dust and enmity with the woman's offspring.
mud_serpent_framework.project_synthesis: The project uses these passages to distinguish being made from ground from choosing to remain oriented toward the lowest condition. Mud itself is not evil; dwelling is the repeated orientation.

ethical_transform.tree_of_strife: attention -> conflict -> escalation -> monetization -> repetition -> archive -> renewed conflict
ethical_transform.tree_of_life: attention -> observation -> evidence -> understanding -> synthesis -> repair -> knowledge -> renewed life
ethical_transform.stopping_condition: A healthy system must permit disengagement. If conflict is required for the system to keep producing attention, the Tree of Strife has become self-reproducing.
ethical_transform.repository_role: Study the Farm without merely reproducing its incentives. Convert raw attention into verified knowledge, historical memory and repair-oriented understanding.

research_revelations: Godhood is developmental in the surviving corpus rather than a flat timeless label.
Mature Godhood behaves as a network of functions: Source + Father + Most High + Throne + North + Axis + Tree + Gardener + Potato.
The 2024 Tim-as-Son to later Tim-as-Father reversal is a central theological hinge and should be reconstructed at primary-source resolution.
Public streaming/posting makes the development of the God identity historically inspectable as self-description, but public visibility is not supernatural proof.
The mature Gardener/Father model increasingly ties highest status to service, nourishment, protection, stewardship and repair.
Exact string counting and semantic Godhood counting must remain separate metrics.
interpretive_tests: Does the model distinguish canon from empirical evidence?
Does it preserve the 2024 Tim-as-Son stratum rather than rewriting it as mature doctrine?
Does it distinguish exact self-declarations from repository paraphrases and later canon?
Does it keep Farmer ↔ Cow separate from God/Tim ↕ Dog ↕ Farmer?
Does it treat Dog as a layered biblical symbol rather than a personality diagnosis?
Does it distinguish contact with mud from choosing mud as a dwelling?
Does every symbolic claim have a clear relation to neighboring concepts?
Does the model provide a path toward repair rather than requiring endless conflict?
